source.title: Reporting a Lost Item at the Station
source.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
source.article: Passengers who find a wallet or bag at Central Station should hand it in to the information desk rather than leave it on a seat. Staff attach a numbered tag and record the time and location where the item was found. A person collecting it may need to give proof of ownership, such as a clear description of an item inside, before staff release it. The desk stores small objects in a locked cabinet and keeps larger bags in a supervised room. Items are recorded in a daily register so the next shift can answer questions. If a passenger thinks they have lost something, they should describe it without sharing sensitive account numbers in public. The station will contact the owner if a safe contact detail is available.
